summary: Phase 12b (Before/After Frequency Map) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: all 6 pytest cases in test_before_after.py pass (401 no-auth, 402 free user, empty state, eigenmode-only, full shape/classification, celebration on 5th session). Endpoint /api/harmonic-blueprint/before-after returns correct payload keys (baseline, latest, band_deltas, summary_text, session_count, show_celebration). Band classification thresholds verified: |delta|<2 -> aligned+improved, 2-4 -> near, >=4 -> drift. Celebration flag correctly toggles every 5th non-baseline session (session_count%5==0 && >0). Summary text uses the expected phrasing: 'strengthened significantly since you began' + 'continues to show some drift and remains a focus area' + 'holding steady' for stable case. Frontend: logged in as seeded Pro user with 1 eigenmode + 1 non-baseline session; Account -> Harmonic Blueprint section renders the new BEFORE & AFTER FREQUENCY MAP card with two panels (baseline + latest), gold bars on baseline, teal/gold/amber colouring on latest matching alignment, per-band deltas ('Δ -5.0 dB', 'Δ -3.0 dB') for non-aligned bands, legend (Aligned/Near/Drift), and exact plain-language summary sentence. All required data-testids present: before-after-map, before-after-panel-baseline, before-after-panel-latest, before-after-band-{which}-{key} for all 6 bands x 2 panels, before-after-map-summary. Code path in HarmonicBlueprintSheet.jsx L340 verified: confirmFindings() posts profile then GETs /before-after and sets celebrationData if show_celebration===true, mounting <BeforeAfterCelebration data=... onClose=... /> at L573-582 which renders inner <BeforeAfterMap data compact /> with close & continue buttons (data-testid=before-after-celebration, -close, -continue). Regression: Drift Over Time (timeline) still renders alongside new card. Gap Closure Progress card not shown for this seed (no confirmed_gaps) which matches known conditional render.
